resources.string: Choose a payment method at checkout and bring one complete payment QR code into view, then try again.
This checkout asks you to continue inside WeChat. Copy the official top-up link, open WeChat and send it to File Transfer. Open the link there, check your account and choose an amount.

Scan with WeChat on another device and check the recipient and amount. To use this phone, open the official top-up page inside WeChat. The original order stays here. Check your paid orders before starting another top-up.
Scan this code with Alipay on another device. Check the recipient and amount in Alipay before paying.
Copy top-up link and open WeChat
Top-up link copied. You can open it inside WeChat.
